sentences.text: ...for the petitioner.
Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherjee, Ld.P.P. Mr. Imran Ali Ms. Debjani Sahu.
...for the State.
Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon Mr. Imran Ali, learned advocate, who ordinarily appears on behalf of the State.
His appearance may be regularised by the concerned authorities.

The subject matter of the case relates to Sections 51 and 59 of the Food Safety & Standards Act,
2006 pending in the court of learned CJM, Purba Bardhaman.

Learned advocate for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is a General Manager of a company,
namely, Red Cow Private Limited.
The subject matter of the case is under Section 77 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and is barred under law.
However, the petitioner submits that the petitioner have challenged the initial analyst report so submitted before the concerned court.
Since the outcome of the second report is still pending, I am not inclined to interfere at this stage.
Petitioner is granted liberty to approach this Court aftr the second report is received by the petitioner.
With the aforesaid directions, CRR 3326 of 2022 is disposed of.
